questions.question: What is the theme for National Science Day 2025?

options.text: Integrated Approach in S&T for Sustainable Future
Empowering Indian Youth for Global Leadership in Science & lnnovation for Viksit Bharat

questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Empowering Indian Youth for Global Leadership in Science & lnnovation for Viksit Bharat**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• ** National Science Day 2025: 28 February.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• The day is celebrated in India to commemorate the **discovery of the 'Raman Effect' by Indian physicist Sir Chandrasekhara Venkata Raman on 28 February 1928.**
 
• The **Raman Effect** is the phenomenon of the scattering of light when it passes through a transparent material, leading to a change in its wavelength and energy.
 
• This discovery was a significant contribution to the field of physics and earned Sir **C.V. Raman the Nobel Prize in Physics in 1930**, making him the **first Indian to receive this prestigious award in science**.
 
• The theme for National Science Day 2025 is **'*Empowering Indian Youth for Global Leadership in Science & lnnovation for Viksit Bharat*****'**.

questions.question: Which poem by Vinayak Damodar Savarkar has been selected to receive the first Chhatrapati Sambhaji Maharaj Rajya Prerna Geet Award?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**"Anadi Mi, Anant Mi"**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Vinayak Damodar Savarkar's poem "Anadi Mi, Anant Mi" will receive the first Chhatrapati Sambhaji Maharaj Rajya Prerna Geet Award.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Maharashtra government introduced the Chhatrapati Sambhaji Maharaj Rajya Prerna Geet Award to honor the legacy of Chhatrapati Sambhaji Maharaj.**
 
• The award recognizes powerful poetry that inspired the state during challenging times.
 
• Savarkar's poem "Anadi Mi, Anant Mi" was composed during his captivity in Marseilles, where he was inspired by the poetry to continue his fight for India's freedom.
 
• The award includes a cash prize of Rs two lakh and a memento.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Chhatrapati Sambhaji Maharaj__

 __
 
• Chhatrapati Sambhaji Maharaj was the son of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj, the founder of the Maratha Empire.
 
• He was a warrior and a Sanskrit scholar, who made significant contributions to the administration and culture of the Maratha Empire.
 
 
 
• Vinayak Damodar Savarkar__
 __
 
• Vinayak Damodar Savarkar was a prominent freedom fighter, revolutionary, and social reformer who played a key role in the Indian independence movement.
 
• He is well-known for his book "The History of the First War of Indian Independence, 1857" and for his efforts in freeing India from British rule.
 
 
 
• The Chhatrapati Sambhaji Maharaj Rajya Prerna Geet Award__
 
 
• This award is introduced by the Maharashtra government to honor the legacy of Chhatrapati Sambhaji Maharaj.
 
• The award recognizes powerful poetry that has inspired the state during difficult periods of history.

questions.question: Which country has become the second in the world to introduce digital pilot licenses, termed "Electronic Personnel License"?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **India becomes the second country to introduce digital pilot licenses (EPL) following ICAO's approval.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Union Minister for Civil Aviation, Ram Mohan Naidu, introduced the Electronic Personnel License (EPL), making India the second country to implement this after ICAO's approval.**
 
• **The EPL will be available digitally through the eGCA Mobile Application, replacing traditional physical licenses.**
 
• **The initiative aims to streamline the licensing process, improve security and transparency, and align with India’s “Ease of Doing Business” and “Digital India” vision.**
 
• **India’s aviation sector is rapidly expanding, and the introduction of EPL is expected to reduce the reliance on physical licenses, cutting delays and promoting sustainability.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO)__

 __
 
• ICAO is a specialized agency of the United Nations that promotes the safe and orderly development of international civil aviation.
 
• It sets standards and regulations necessary for the safety, security, efficiency, and environmental protection of international air transport.
 
 
 
• eGCA (Electronic General Civil Aviation)__
 __
 
• eGCA is an online platform developed by the Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA) for issuing pilot licenses, which ensures a paperless process and digital verification of credentials.
 
 
 
• Plastic and Paper Usage Reduction__
 
 
• The shift from physical to digital licenses will significantly reduce the environmental footprint of the aviation industry by decreasing the use of plastic and paper materials.

questions.question: Who has been appointed as the new Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) of India in February 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Gyanesh Kumar.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Gyanesh Kumar has been appointed as the new Chief Election Commissioner, replacing Rajiv Kumar.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gyanesh Kumar is a 1988-batch IAS officer from the Kerala cadre, and he replaces Rajiv Kumar as the Chief Election Commissioner.**
 
• The appointment was made following a selection process involving Prime Minister Narendra Modi and other senior leaders.
 
• This is the first appointment of the CEC under the Chief Election Commissioner and Other Election Commissioner Act, 2023.
 
• Gyanesh Kumar's appointment follows the retirement of Rajiv Kumar, who led the Commission from May 2022.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Chief Election Commissioner (CEC)__

 __
 
• The CEC is the head of the Election Commission of India, overseeing the administration and conduct of elections in the country.
 
• The CEC is appointed for a fixed tenure and plays a crucial role in ensuring free and fair elections.
 
 
 
• Election Commissioner__
 __
 
• Election Commissioners work alongside the CEC and help manage the electoral process, with a focus on policy, planning, and execution.
 
• The Election Commission is a constitutional body tasked with administering elections in India at the central and state levels.
 
 
 
• Rajiv Kumar__
 __
 
• Rajiv Kumar served as the 25th CEC and oversaw key elections including the 2024 Lok Sabha elections.
 
• He was credited for implementing reforms and ensuring peaceful elections during his tenure.
 
 
 
• The Chief Election Commissioner and Other Election Commissioner Act, 2023__
 
 
• This Act outlines the process of appointing and managing Election Commissioners and the CEC, ensuring an independent and impartial electoral body.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://ddnews.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/Gyanesh-kumar-1.jpg]

questions.question: Which company has become the first private entity to invest in India's nuclear power sector?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Jindal Nuclear**____**.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Jindal Nuclear plans to build 18GWe nuclear power generation capacity with an investment of Rs 1.80 lakh crore.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jindal Nuclear will invest Rs 1.80 lakh crore over the next two decades to set up 18GWe nuclear power generation capacity.**
 
• The company intends to develop a diverse mix of advanced nuclear technologies such as Bharat Small Reactors (BSRs), Small Modular Reactors (SMRs), and Gen-IV Reactors.
 
• Jindal Nuclear is the first private sector company in India to invest in nuclear energy to support the country’s low-carbon energy transition.
 
• The project will contribute significantly to India’s target of achieving 100GWe nuclear energy by 2047.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Jindal Nuclear__

 __
 
• Part of Naveen Jindal Group
 
• Wholly owned subsidiary of Jindal Renewables
 
• Focuses on CO2-free energy future through nuclear power development
 
 
 
• Nuclear Energy in India__
 
 
• India targets 100GWe of nuclear power by 2047 as per Union Budget 2025
 
• Nuclear energy is a crucial part of the country’s low-carbon energy transition plan

questions.question: N. Biren Singh resigned as the Chief Minister of Manipur ahead of the no-confidence motion in 2025, When did he assume office as the Chief Minister of Manipur?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**2017**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Manipur Chief Minister N Biren Singh resigned** nearly two years after ethnic violence erupted in the state.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• He **submitted his resignation to Governor Ajay Kumar Bhalla** amid talks of a no-confidence motion and floor test by Congress.
 
• Singh **expressed gratitude to the central government** for its interventions and developmental work in his resignation letter.
 
• His resignation **followed a meeting with Union Home Minister Amit Shah** in New Delhi.
 
• The BJP holds **32 seats in the 60-member Manipur Assembly**, with support from **five NPF MLAs and six JD(U) MLAs**.
 
• The **National People's Party (NPP) withdrew support**, but BJP still had a majority.
 
• Speculation arose that **MLAs seeking a leadership change** might defy the party whip in a floor test.
 
• The **Congress holds five seats**, while the opposition NPP has **seven MLAs**, along with **three Independents and two Kuki People's Alliance MLAs**.
 
• **Manipur's 7th Assembly session was scheduled for February 10**, just a day after Singh's resignation.
 
• **Ethnic violence since May 2023** has led to **over 250 deaths and thousands displaced**.
 
• The BJP government **faced scrutiny for its handling of the crisis** and peace restoration efforts.
 
• A day before resigning, Singh stated that his government **was making all efforts to restore peace and unity** in the state.
